name: Wang Dong (Davin)
status: 21 years of experience · Targeting Architect roles · Shanghai · Expecting 50–80K · Open to opportunities while employed
summary: A hybrid technical professional combining software engineering, project management and finance/accounting. Bachelor of Computer Science (Pilot Class) and Bachelor of Finance, plus a Master's in Accounting, all from Shanghai Jiao Tong University. 21 years of experience spanning ICBC Head Office, SAP China Research Institute, Microsoft China, and the payment-clearing and securities/futures industries, with roles as backend developer, product manager, technical manager, senior development manager and system architect. Skilled at building high-availability systems and DevOps/K8s container-cloud platforms from scratch, and led the architecture design and refactoring of core projects including an investment management system, market-data monitoring, an in-house App and the corporate website. Compressed the metric computation for 1,000+ funds from 4–8 hours to 3–5 minutes (100x+ efficiency gain). In recent years focused on domestic-tech (Xinchuang) transformation and applying LLM/Agent to financial scenarios, and independently delivered a low-code AI-assisted programming modernization project via Vibe Coding.

experience.title: Guotai Junan Futures Co., Ltd. · System Development (Architect)

Led unification of architecture across multiple projects, delivered prototype design and technology transfer for core systems, and drove architecture upgrade and refactoring of the investment management system, asset-management website and corporate website; optimized fund analysis performance, cutting processing time for 1,000+ funds from 4–8 hours to 3–5 minutes — a 100x+ efficiency gain.

Built the DevOps system and K8s container-cloud platform from scratch, automating the full development, testing and deployment pipeline with CI/CD coverage approaching 100%, and efficiently supporting delivery of domestic-tech (Xinchuang) transformation initiatives.

Explored domestic-tech (Xinchuang) technology paths and application of Large Language Models (LLM) in financial scenarios; completed technology selection, validation and pilot deployment, advancing intelligent service capabilities.

Responsible for technical talent acquisition and team pipeline development; established R&D standards and code review mechanisms, unified technical standards and improved team collaboration efficiency and engineering quality.

experience.title: Zhuhai Hengqin Jisheng Technology Co., Ltd. · Senior Development Manager
points: Provided technical support to Guosheng Securities, part of the same Guosheng Financial Holding (002670.SZ) group; led architecture design and R&D team management for core systems including market-data monitoring and trading App backend.

Led customized backend development of the Guoshengtong App; designed and implemented an in-house bridging component replacing the vendor's C++ counter trading interface, converting complex trading logic into lightweight Lua scripting — significantly improving development efficiency and reducing maintenance cost.

Built a self-developed high-availability, high-concurrency market-data monitoring and stock price alert system supporting real-time quotes for 6,000+ stocks on the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges, with distributed deployment capability and stable operation for both A-share and 24-hour continuous markets such as Bitcoin.

Built and managed the technical team, recruited and developed core developers, established unified R&D standards and drove CI/CD adoption across projects with continuous integration coverage above 70%.
Key tech stack: Java, K8S, Rancher, C++, Lua, Redis, Kafka.

Owned core modules including the POS transaction system (ISO8583 protocol / HSM communication), clearing system (T+N / D+0 settlement logic) and risk control system, supporting merchant management, account management and transaction risk detection.

Led certification of the domestic UnionPay card payment service system for non-bank financial institutions and the international card industry payment security standard (PCI DSS) system certification.

As product manager in the payment team, coordinated payment requirements from business units, worked with legal to assess compliance and with finance to analyze financial statement impact, authored requirement documents, reviewed system design and implementation costs with the engineering team, and managed development, testing and launch end to end.

Participated in the Xbox One launch online pre-order project, extending the credit card payment product with a pre-authorized credit payment method. Through effective cross-team communication and resource coordination, advanced the Xbox One pre-order date from June 19, 2013 to June 11, 2013 to precisely match the E3 gaming expo launch cadence, earning high recognition from the gaming division director.

Participated in the second-phase Office 365 launch project for the SMB market, helping design and implement the payment solution and supporting a successful business launch, with positive feedback from the business team.

projects.title: Guotai Junan Futures Investment Management Project · Backend Development
projects.meta: Calmar/Sharpe/IR/Sortino metrics · Multi-process & multi-threaded · Vectorized computing · 2023.11 – 2025.06
points: Contributed to backend development of the investment management system, covering pre-investment analysis and post-investment management modules supporting investment decisions and return tracking for the company's proprietary capital.

The pre-investment module computes multi-dimensional metrics for private funds (Calmar, Sharpe, Information Ratio, Sortino, etc.), screens high-quality funds from an observation pool into strategy simulation via quantitative scoring, and integrates market indices, basis data and due diligence report management to improve researcher decision efficiency.

The post-investment module precisely calculates actual investment returns at fund, strategy and department level based on subscription/redemption records, NAV changes, fee accrual rules and index hedging trade data.

Combining multi-process, multi-threaded and vectorized computing to fully refactor the fund metric computation module, reducing key metric computation for 1,000+ funds from 90 seconds to 3–5 seconds and cutting overall system runtime from 4–8 hours to 3–5 minutes.

Led the design and implementation of whole-market quote data persistence, real-time exposure calculation and real-time stock index basis calculation, integrating and storing 2,000+ real-time stock index option quotes; a single server supports 20 concurrent users each viewing real-time basis for 16 stock index futures on one screen, ran stably through the extreme market conditions of the 2024 National Day holiday, and retains ample performance headroom.

projects.title: 3rd Pazhou Algorithm Competition · Team Lead / Convener

The preliminary-round solution closely matched the official reference answer, ranking in the top 20% overall.

Built unified CI/CD pipelines on GitLab and Kubernetes/Rancher so that front-end and back-end services are automatically built, deployed and released on commit, significantly improving release efficiency.

Built an EFK log collection and analysis platform for centralized log management and rapid troubleshooting; participated in technology selection and procurement decisions for the monitoring platform, advancing operations toward automation and visualization.
All backend applications achieved automatic packaging and one-click release, laying the groundwork for the subsequent successful launch of the Guotai Junan Futures in-house App.
